header.running_head: 4. Virtues of the Dhikr of Allah...

blocks.tamil_translation: Rasulullah ﷺ replied, “The best words are the words Allah has chosen for His angels or for His righteous servants, and that is “Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi'.” Hazrat Abu Dharr (RA) narrates this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ قَالَ لَا إِلهَ إِلَّا اللهُ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ أَوْ وَجَبَتْ لَهُ الْجَنَّةُ وَمَنْ قَالَ: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَبِحَمْدِه مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ كَتَبَ اللهُ لَهُ مِائَةَ اَلْفِ حَسَنَةٍ وَأَرْبَعاً وَّعِشْرِينَ اَلْفَ حَسَنَةٍ قَالُوا: يارَسُولَ اللهِ! إِذاً لَّا يَهْلِكُ مِنَّا أَحَدٌ؟ قَالَ: بَلَي إِنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ لَيَجِيءُ بِالْحَسَنَاتِ لَوْ وُضِعَتْ عَلَي جَبَلٍ أَثْقَلَتْهُ ثُمَّ تَجِيءُ النِّعَمُ فَتَذْهَبُ بِتِلْكَ ثُمَّ يَتَطَاوَلُ الرَّبُّ بَعْدَ ذلِكَ بِرَحْمَتِهِ.
blocks.tamil_translation: When Rasulullah ﷺ said, “Whoever says the Kalimah “La ilaha illallah', Jannah becomes obligatory for him. Whoever says “Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi' a hundred times, one hundred and twenty-four thousand good deeds (1,24,000) are written for him,” the Sahabah asked, “Ya Rasulallah! In that case, (on the Day of Qiyamah) since the good deeds will be so many, no one will be destroyed, will they?' (Some will be destroyed, because) Rasulullah ﷺ said, “One of you will bring a great many good deeds. He will bring so many good deeds that if they were placed on a mountain, the mountain would sink down. Then the blessings (Ni'mah) of Allah will be brought, and before the bounties of Allah all these good deeds will become nothing. Then Allah, by His grace, will help whom He wills and save him from destruction.” Hazrat Abu Talhah (RA) has narrated this.
